mcq.q: What is the name of the story?
mcq.why: This lesson's story is Talent show.

mcq.q: Complete: Sami and Lottie meet a friendly ___ at the talent show.
mcq.why: They meet Bailey, a friendly cat.
These words come from the Talent show story.

o: She can't get the balls out.
mcq.why: Bo helps her with the balls on stage.

mcq.q: Put in order: a) The cat runs onto the stage. b) Fatma eats a banana. c) Everyone says Fatma is the best.
mcq.why: Banana first, then the cat, then everyone praises Fatma.

mcq.q: Your friend is nervous before a talent show. What can you say?
o: Don't worry! You're great at singing. You can do it!
mcq.why: Encouraging words help a friend feel confident.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: Tameem is very shy when he's on stage.
o: Tameem is very confident when he's on stage.
Tameem is very lazy when he's on stage.
Tameem is very rude when he's on stage.
Tameem is very shy when he's at home.
mcq.why: In the story, Tameem is confident on stage.

mcq.q: How do we know Fatma was nervous before the show?
o: She said "I'm feeling worse and worse".
mcq.why: Her words and Lottie's "Don't worry" show she was nervous.

mcq.q: What does Bo helping Fatma show about him?
o: He is kind and a good friend.
mcq.why: Helping a friend with a problem is kind.

mcq.q: Why does Lottie give Fatma a banana?
o: Fatma needs energy for the show.
mcq.why: Fatma didn't eat after lunch, and food gives energy.
